premises.text: Social TV and similar experiences create a hard real-time big-data problem of processing huge concurrent streams and broadcasting results back instantly
premises.evidence_span: That's a real-time big data problem, where you have to take that deluge of data, you have to process it, and then you have to transmit it back out to the audience very, very quickly

premises.text: Bright Context is a cloud developer platform for processing in-flight real-time data streams and incorporating push/broadcast into apps via an easy API
premises.evidence_span: we provide a cloud-based platform for software developers that makes it easy to do two key things

premises.text: Through channels and quant channels with inputs, processing, and outputs plus an SDK offload scaling complexity from app builders
premises.evidence_span: There's a thing called a through channel, which is for broadcasting data without processing it

premises.text: The platform packages stream processing with broadcast/push, stores real-time history, and lowers barriers via dashboard, API, and cloud pricing
premises.evidence_span: we provide both data stream processing as well as data broadcast and push in one package

premises.text: Adoption is driven by self-service engagement of innovative developers across use cases beyond social TV
premises.evidence_span: we're engaging developers directly through a self-service model

value.text: Developers can gift-wrap real-time stream processing and push into apps and innovate around real-time
value.evidence_span: This is the problem that Bright Context Platform solves, and we gift wrap it for developers

causal_links.evidence_span: This problem right here, this is a hard problem
you've offloaded a huge amount of complexity to us in terms of scaling and back-end
adopted more broadly, more quickly, and more creatively through partnering with innovative developers
